description: This file defines a custom exception class 'KeyHandlerException' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling exceptions related to key management. It provides static methods to generate specific exception instances with relevant messages.

classes.name: KeyHandlerException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods to generate specific key-related exception instances.

methods.name: keyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Creates a new KeyHandlerException indicating that a key already exists.

methods.name: failedToCreateKey
methods.description: Creates a new KeyHandlerException indicating failure to create a key.

methods.name: keyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Creates a new KeyHandlerException indicating that a key file does not exist.

methods.name: keyIsNotReadable
methods.description: Creates a new KeyHandlerException indicating that a key is not readable.
